items.text: Thinking about life insurance for a child or grandchild? A small whole life policy can stay with them for life and builds cash value over time. Coverage bought young can mean they hold a policy even if their health changes later. We can explain how these policies work and what to ask before you buy. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146 or visit honorbrook-insurance.com.
